protocol.context_selection: First native training-size seed for each cue/upper-branch key/ball combination
protocol.forced_path: Action2 from x1 east to fork; final target0(top) or1(bottom) from visible objects
protocol.objective: Final turn logits0:2 cross entropy; unchanged seven-output model and complete sequence gradients
protocol.batch: All four unique balanced native contexts in fixed canonical order at every update
protocol.evaluation: Report both seven-action and two-candidate probabilities; same four selected seeds at every length
protocol.state_ablation: reset_all clears GRU/store each step; reset_store clears only matrix before each write
protocol.selection: No early stopping, checkpoint selection, budget extension or accuracy-based retuning
protocol.scope: Four-context supervised candidate choice and forced-path length transfer only
protocol.sole_training_intervention: Cross entropy normalizes over candidates0,1 instead of all seven actions
protocol.telemetry: Post-fit intact sequences only; write strengths and opposite-cue state distances are descriptive

continuation.scope: Development continuation only, not robust generalization, gameplay, RL or novelty

protocol.comparison: Post-run exact tensor equality of freshly trained GRU fits versus memory-optimization-v1 recursive ce2

results.interpretation: Post-fit state/write statistics, not information content or proof of usable memory
